unsupported: The parent company, Zhejiang Sanhua Automotive Parts Co., Ltd., is a subsidiary of the publicly listed Zhejiang Sanhua Intelligent Controls (stock code 002050) and began as a developer of automotive thermal valves in Hangzhou, China.
The U.S. entity was established to support the company's expanding North American R&D center and customer base.

The company designs and manufactures a broad range of thermal-management components for new-energy vehicles, including electronic expansion valves, solenoid valves, electronic water and oil pumps, heat exchangers, battery cold plates, liquid receivers, and gas-liquid separators.
Its core technologies span heat-pump systems, control-valve assemblies, heat-exchange engineering, and variable-frequency control.

Globally, the organization employs over 9,600 people, with more than 1,000 dedicated to research and development across four technical centers in China, North America, and Europe, and operates five production bases in China, Mexico, Europe, and India.

It emphasizes integrated thermal-management solutions that improve vehicle efficiency and extend driving range, backed by national-level engineering centers, comprehensive testing capabilities, and a portfolio of over 740 patents.
